title: Infrastructure Strike — Kharkiv (Ukraine)
description: A strike on energy infrastructure near Kharkiv reported by several independent outlets. Includes one syndicated wire copy to show that republication does NOT inflate the independent-source count. High-resolution damage assessment would be a CV Replay/benchmark task, never a live Sentinel-2 claim.

expected.note: 4 articles but one is a wire republication -> independent sources < article count
